issues.title: LocalStorage Plaintext Session Tokens
issues.evidence: Authorization bearer token matches plaintext user ID or email without signature validation.
issues.recommendedFix: Implement cryptographic JWT verification using a real auth provider (e.g. Firebase Auth or Supabase Auth) and secure httpOnly cookies.
issues.acceptanceCriteria: All request tokens must be cryptographically signed, checked for expiration, and reject manual plaintext spoofing.

issues.title: Local JSON Flat-file Persistence
issues.evidence: Data state is written locally to data/db.json flat-file database using the local storage driver.
issues.recommendedFix: Map local files to persistent disk volumes or configure a live relational database.
issues.acceptanceCriteria: JSON file is backed up daily and mapped to persistent disk space.

issues.title: Mocked Relational Database Client
issues.evidence: Supabase client setup checks variables, but MemoryRepository handles all writes solely in-memory without making SQL queries.
issues.recommendedFix: Implement database table structures and update MemoryRepository to use real SQL clients or Supabase SDK.
issues.acceptanceCriteria: All CRUD actions persist directly to Supabase/PostgreSQL tables.

issues.title: Unencrypted Client LocalStorage Data Cache
issues.evidence: Session tokens and active profile configurations are stored in plaintext localStorage variables.
issues.recommendedFix: Limit cached items and transition to secure session cookies.
issues.acceptanceCriteria: No plaintext session keys are stored in unencrypted browser client caches.
